Want the best camera features? Do you have to buy Apple's largest iPhone Pro? For generations, the answer has been mixed. So far, most reports suggest there will be no camera differences between the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, but today a leaker has cast some doubt on that claim.

Specifically, they say two new features originally expected to apply to both Pro models may instead be Pro Max exclusives…

The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max offer identical camera specs, with all three rear lenses featuring 48-megapixel sensors. Apple says the telephoto lens offers up to 8x optical zoom, but this is actually achieved through cropping a 24-megapixel image, so it would be more accurate to say it offers 4x optical zoom, with an 8x cropped image option.

So far, expectations have largely been that this year's two Pro models will maintain parity in camera features, with both getting a variable aperture main lens, and a wider aperture telephoto lens that delivers better low-light performance.

However, leaker Ice Universe says two new telephoto lens features may be exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

If true, this means that if you want the longest telephoto reach and the best low-light performance, you'll have to buy the Pro Max. However, the use of the word "may" suggests they're not very confident in this claim, perhaps having seen conflicting evidence in Apple's supply chain.

There are also reports that the variable aperture system on the main lens may be a Pro Max exclusive, but reports are mixed on this.

If you've always preferred the smaller of the two Pro models, but the Pro Max is the only one offering the better camera features, would you upgrade to the Pro Max? Let us know in the comments.
